items.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to {@spell burning hands}, {@spell fireball}, and {@spell scorching ray}.

items.name: Flaming Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) fire damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) fire damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Conjure Sword
entries: As a bonus action on its first turn in combat, the helmed horror conjures a longsword-sized blade of fire, which appears in its free hand. This sword disappears in a cloud of smoke when the helmed horror drops to 0 hit points.
